## 2024-03-24 - [O(1) Text Highlight Lookups]
**Learning:** When using `String.prototype.split` with a capturing regular expression (e.g., `/(pattern)/`), the resulting array always interleaves non-matching parts with matching parts. This guarantees that matches are consistently placed at odd indices (1, 3, 5, etc.) in the array.
**Action:** Replace `O(N*M)` array `.some()` lookups with an `O(1)` mathematical index check (`index % 2 === 1`) when mapping over text segments generated by a capturing regex split.
